entities.summary: Michael Anthony Strahan is an American television host and former professional football player. He spent his entire 15-year football career as a defensive end for the New York Giants of the National Football League (NFL). A dominant pass rusher, Strahan set the NFL single-season record for quarterback sacks and helped the Giants win Super Bowl XLII in his final season in 2007. He was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2014.
